title: Law to create one online system for senior and disability rent freeze benefits
summary: This bill would require the Department of Finance and Department of Housing Preservation and Development to jointly create a single universal application and recertification system for the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption and Disability Rent Increase Exemption programs. It would also require an online application website and online recertification process for both programs. Both were originally required by December 31, 2025, while paper applications would still be accepted.
